description: This file defines a KafkaClientActor class which manages Kafka connection operations within an Akka actor system. It handles connection setup, testing, publishing, and cleanup, and interacts with other internal actors related to Kafka publishing.

classes.name: KafkaClientActor
classes.description: Actor managing Kafka connectivity, including connection, testing, publisher life cycle, and resource cleanup within an Akka system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration for instantiating KafkaClientActor with given parameters.

methods.name: validateConnection
methods.description: Validates or processes the Connection object before use; currently a placeholder returning the connection as-is.

methods.name: inTestingState
methods.description: Defines behavior for the testing state, handling success and failure responses.

methods.name: inConnectingState
methods.description: Defines behavior for the connecting state, handling status reports.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Initiates a test connection operation, returning a Future that completes with success or failure.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Handles initiating a client connection, setting up Kafka publisher.

methods.name: doDisconnectClient
methods.description: Handles disconnecting the client by sending a disconnect message.

methods.name: getPublisherActor
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef to the Kafka publisher actor.

methods.name: connectClient
methods.description: Starts connector and publisher components, optionally in dry run mode.

methods.name: startKafkaPublisher
methods.description: Starts the Kafka publisher actor, ensuring previous instance is stopped.

methods.name: stopPublisherActor
methods.description: Stops the Kafka publisher actor if running.

methods.name: handleStatusReportFromChildren
methods.description: Processes status reports from child actors, updating pending reports and handling failures.

methods.name: completeTestConnectionFuture
methods.description: Completes the ongoing test connection future with success or failure.
